audio.dialogue:
HARRISON BLAKE (V.O.)
While distributed beta instances are tested globally, the Japanese Temple Villa serves as the first full residential integration pilot. To ensure pure data collection, the facility initiates a mandatory lockdown protocol.
audio.voice_direction: Professional, authoritative, and completely detached from the physical reality of the lockdown.

audio.ambience: The fading atmospheric sounds of the evening exterior being systematically choked out by the engaging containment shell.
